intro: Iraq has some of the largest oil reserves in the world, and oil pays for almost all of the government's budget.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Most oil comes from the south around Basra and is shipped through the Gulf. Kirkuk in the north is another big oil field.
Relying so heavily on oil makes the economy swing with oil prices.

chapters.title: Beyond oil
text: Dates were once Iraq's most famous export; the country had millions of date palms. Farming, building and religious tourism employ many people, and the government is the largest employer.

keyTerms.meaning: Oil known to be in the ground and possible to extract.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Iraq makes and sells to the world.
